desc.en: A Bachelor specialisation course taught as a workshop, not a lecture: eleven two-hour sessions in which fifteen students measure how AI answer engines and social platforms actually decide what to recommend, publish a real intervention in week 3, and read the result eleven weeks later. desc.en: A Master of International Management core course taught as a build lab, not a lecture: eleven two-hour Thursday sessions in which teams take one company's five incompatible data sources and give it a KPI tree, a star schema, a pipeline, a tested finding, a dashboard and a churn model — then argue in presentation week that the decision they sealed in October actually changed. The full analytics lifecycle, in the order it happens; Looker Studio and Colab; one running case.
